baseline.denominator_kind: handwritten production-file total including inline tests, not pure implementation
baseline.test_span_classification: unresolved; declarations are not AST counts or measured spans

physical_lines.algorithm: len(data.splitlines()) where data is exact Python bytes
physical_lines.generated_form: pinned reproducible expanded source; no compressed or packed-behavior substitution

charge_scope.union: unique required source paths across all declared production builds and consumers
include: Doe-owned/maintained implementation, headers, ABI adapters/glue, build/packaging logic
new or expanded migration-required dependency code, including required transitive source
charge_scope.generated_accounting: charge maintained generator/input source and required expanded output; retain separate subtotals and provenance
charge_scope.shared_target_paths: count once in source union; report target views separately
charge_scope.distinct_required_duplicate_paths: count each; installed duplicate copies also retain byte accounting
charge_scope.dependency_boundary: identify exact required unchanged and expanded parts with auditable allocation
charge_scope.unchanged_platform_toolchain_or_third_pa: separate pinned dependency and installed-footprint ledger, not an unreported zero or newly charged whole libc/compiler
charge_scope.non_source_assets: report bytes separately; encoded behavior must have inspectable expanded source accounting
charge_scope.transitional_adapters: charge while production-required; remove only with consumer/build retirement evidence
charge_scope.final_no_zig: no implementation, generation, link or runtime fallback dependency on Zig

required_report_views: tests and tooling with overlaps explicit

test_span_audit.artifact: source-hash-bound reviewed half-open byte intervals, test-only purpose, suite and evidence
test_span_audit.method: pinned structural/parser method plus human review, not lexical declaration count
test_span_audit.remove_from_implementation: only physical lines wholly inside audited exclusively test-only spans
test_span_audit.blank_comment_indent_delimiter_lines: follow reviewed enclosing span, never cosmetic subtraction
test_span_audit.reconciliation: implementation lines plus exclusively test-only excluded lines equals charged physical-file lines
test_span_audit.test_movement: symmetric span exclusion, preserved defect detection, no automatic implementation win

claim_conditions_all_required.headline_comparability: deliberately stricter closure than frozen handwritten denominator; not itself a like-for-like implementation comparison
claim_conditions_all_required.normalized_condition: 2 * final implementation-only lines <= baseline implementation-only lines
claim_conditions_all_required.normalized_scope: same declared feature and consumer scope with independently audited full closures and test spans
claim_conditions_all_required.identity_drift_or_missing_input: refuse claim, retain observed diagnostic result
